title: AccountConflict409Response
description: Response schema for 409 Conflict when a duplicate CustodyAccount (same AccountNumber + Custodian) is detected. Returned as ProblemDetails format.

type.description: Problem type identifier - must be 'already-exists' for duplicate account detection

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem

detail.description: A human-readable explanation containing the duplicate account's ID

instance.description: The API endpoint path for this request
